summary: Checkout is personal-use shippable with caveats; not external-release ready. Strongest blockers: welcome modal every launch (parked TODO), README/menu recording UX mismatch (no Start/Stop in tray), and ad-hoc-only packaging (no Developer ID/notarization). Recording lifecycle code has stop/quit persistence paths and unit tests for start/stop/save, but quit-while-recording and live capture/permission flows remain manual.
findings: HIGH — Welcome blocks every launch. Trigger: app launch → AppDelegate.applicationDidFinishLaunching calls showWelcomeInfo() which always runModal(). Consequence: user must dismiss a blocking alert every start; contradicts Dev/pre-release-todo.md decision (once-only). Exact: Sources/AppDelegate.swift:53,57-81; Dev/pre-release-todo.md:1-8.

HIGH (external) / MEDIUM (personal) — Documented menu recording control is absent. Trigger: open menu-bar menu expecting Start/Stop Recording (README). Actual menu is only Settings + Quit (TrayService.makeMenu). Recording start/stop is hotkey-only (AppDelegate.toggleRecording via HotKeyService). README also claims macOS 14 menu explains unavailability; that UI path does not exist (unavailable alert only if start() is invoked). Consequence: discoverability/docs lie; if Option+Shift+5 fails to register, no in-app recording control. Exact: Sources/TrayService.swift:16-30,35-48; README.md:118-133; Sources/AppDelegate.swift:142-163; Sources/ScreenRecordingService.swift:92-98.

BLOCKER for external release; OK for private personal use — Packaging is ad-hoc only. scripts/build_app.sh signs with codesign --force --deep --sign - (identity `-`), no Developer ID, notarization, stapling, or hardened-runtime entitlements. Generated Info.plist has NSAppleEventsUsageDescription + LSMinimumSystemVersion 14.0 but no NSScreenCaptureUsageDescription. Consequence: fine for local `./scripts/build_app.sh` personal builds; Gatekeeper/notarized third-party distribution is not configured. Exact: scripts/build_app.sh:133-156.
decisions: Capped at 3 strongest release-relevant issues; architecture style and try? alone not treated as defects.
Separated private personal-use (ad-hoc .app OK) from external release (needs real signing/notarization + tray/docs/welcome polish).
Did not elevate missing NSScreenCaptureUsageDescription to a confirmed runtime blocker without a live TCC/prompt observation; listed under manual gaps.
Did not treat pre-release TODO #2 dropdown dismissal as a confirmed defect (suspected, not verified).
Builds/tests/app launch not run per assignment constraints; production paths and test source verified by reading only.
